statements.attributed: the Hf-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr HEA is the first superconducting HEA
statements.quote: This HEA is historically also the first superconducting HEA .

statements.attributed: alloying small amounts of Sc (a few %) into aluminum alloys causes a beneficial strengthening effect due to the formation of Al3Sc intermetallic precipitates
statements.quote: Alloying small amounts of Sc (a few %) into aluminum alloys has been demonstrated to cause a beneficial strengthening effect due to the formation of Al3Sc intermetallic precipitates , making the Sc-Al lightweight alloys for aerospace components the main application of scandium.

statements.attributed: alloying 0.3–5 wt.% of Sc into 3d transition-metals-based HEAs Al2CoCrFeNi, Al0.5CoCrCuFeNi and AlCoCrCu0.5FeNi results in a powerful increase of hardness due to the precipitation-hardening effect
statements.quote: Alloying 0.3–5 wt.% of Sc into 3d transition-metals-based HEAs Al2CoCrFeNi, Al0.5CoCrCuFeNi and AlCoCrCu0.5FeNi has been demonstrated to result in a powerful increase of hardness due to the precipitation-hardening effect .

statements.attributed: a 3% Sc addition to the Al2CoCrFeNi HEA resulted in the precipitation of the ternary Al2Cu3Sc intermetallic phase, which, in combination with high-pressure sintering, significantly improved the hardness and thermal stability of the alloy
statements.quote: In another work, a 3% Sc addition to the Al2CoCrFeNi HEA has resulted in the precipitation of the ternary Al2Cu3Sc intermetallic phase, which, in combination with high-pressure sintering, has significantly improved the hardness and thermal stability of the alloy, making it suitable for the application in extreme environments .

statements.attributed: in the equimolar AlCrCuScTi HEA, the formation and degradation of the Al3Sc, Al2Cu3Sc and Al4Cu4Sc intermetallic precipitates upon heating plays a crucial role in the record high value of the hardness/density ratio of this alloy
statements.quote: Sc has also been incorporated as one of the principal elements into equimolar AlCrCuScTi HEA , where it was observed that the formation and degradation of the Al3Sc, Al2Cu3Sc and Al4Cu4Sc intermetallic precipitates upon heating plays a crucial role in the record high value of the hardness/density ratio of this alloy, in comparison with ordinary heavy refractory HEAs.

statements.attributed: the Sc-containing Al20Li20Mg10Sc20Ti30 single-phase nanocrystalline HEA is as strong as Ti, light as Al and as hard as some ceramics
statements.quote: Moreover, the Sc-containing Al20Li20Mg10Sc20Ti30 single-phase nanocrystalline HEA has proven to be as strong as Ti, light as Al and as hard as some ceramics .

statements.attributed: Sc was used in an attempt to produce hexagonal close-packed (hcp) HEAs in the system Co-Gd-Y-Sc-Ti-Zr
statements.quote: Sc was also used in an attempt to produce hexagonal close-packed (hcp) HEAs in the system Co-Gd-Y-Sc-Ti-Zr, which is composed only of the hcp elements .

statements.attributed: dual hcp structures were found in the ScYLaTiZrHf HEA
statements.quote: Dual hcp structures were also found in the ScYLaTiZrHf HEA .

statements.attributed: binary-mixing enthalpies of the elemental pairs can be used to qualitatively predict the microstructure of the Sc-Hf-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr alloys
statements.quote: The microstructure of the Sc-Hf-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr alloys can be qualitatively predicted by considering binary-mixing enthalpies of the elemental pairs (Table 2) .
